text: Given the normal chest X-ray and CBC, along with your history of heartburn and the cough worsening when lying down, do you experience any regurgitation or a sour taste in your mouth? Additionally, have you noticed any nasal congestion or post-nasal drip that might be irritating your throat?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I often feel a sour taste in my mouth and sometimes notice acid coming up, especially after eating or when I lie down. I also get quite congested at night, which makes the post-nasal drip worse and triggers the cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with Laryngopharyngeal Reflux (LPR) and concurrent Allergic Rhinitis. The combination of sour taste, cough worsening when supine, and post-nasal drip strongly points to reflux irritating the airway and nasal allergies contributing to the symptoms.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
